svg.aria-label: B1-03 — how many points hardly matters; where the window sits matters a hundredfold
svg.desc: Two logarithmic panels sharing a vertical axis of relative error in permeability-thickness. On the left, points per decade from 2 to 200: the curve is almost flat, running from 1.83e-6 down to 1.55e-6, a change of only 1.18 times. On the right, the dimensionless time at which the interpretation window starts, from 10 to 1000: the error falls by two orders of magnitude, from 5.20e-3 to 1.57e-6, following a dashed line that is the 1/(10 t_D) bias predicted in the protocol. Full values in the table below.
